title: Characterization of next-node inputs
statement: Let $r,q$ be natural numbers, let $g$ be an index in a set of size $r^q$, and let $a$ assign a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each of $r$ positions. An index $i$ in the layer of size $r^{q+1}2^r$ belongs to the next-node input set for $(g,a)$ if and only if, under the canonical indexing of that layer by a pair consisting of an index and a sign assignment, there is a position $j$ such that the first component is the child index associated to $(g,j)$ and the product of the signs in the second component differs from $a(j)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is an index in a set of size $r^q$
$a$ assigns a sign to each of $r$ positions
$i$ is an index in the layer of size $r^{q+1}2^r$
